name: Titanoboa
source:
Semyon Persunov is a 27-year-old employee of a scientific laboratory. A certified specialist. A paleontologist. This day was supposed to be a turning point in his fate. Well-preserved fossilized remains of an ancient giant snake were delivered to the institute. Titanoboa - the queen of all snakes that ever lived on planet Earth. The largest representative of its kind. However, instead of new scientific research or writing an article, the turning point in Semyon's life was connected with completely unpredictable circumstances...

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2522905701]Steam[/url]]
